info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Feedback Submission API
info.description: The Customer Feedback Submission API allows businesses to collect and analyze customer reviews pertaining to their services or products. This endpoint enables users to submit new reviews following specific servicing activities, contributing valuable insights for enhancing customer experience. It is typically utilized by customer service teams and product managers aiming to understand customer sentiment and improve operational strategies. By leveraging this API, organizations can streamline the feedback process and drive informed decision-making based on user-generated content.
